name: MUTAKAMELA (Mutakamela Insurance Company, formerly Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company, Tadawul 8040)

audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (33 files in the inventory, all match). Entity: Allianz Saudi Fransi Cooperative Insurance Company until the 2024 annual; the FY2024 annual and every 2025 filing print Mutakamela Insurance Company (formerly Allianz Saudi Fransi), and the FY2025 and 2026 filings print Mutakamela only. Same company (same share capital 600,000,000, same statements chain). All amounts are whole SAR as printed, not thousands.
audit.method: Almost every primary statement of this issuer is image-only or has a scrambled OCR text layer, so each transcribed set was rendered (1.8x to 2x) and read by eye: FY2022 (IFRS 4 original), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1/H1/9M 2024, Q1 2023 and H1 2023 (OCR text layer unusable), Q1 2025, 9M 2025, Q1 2026. Clean text layers were used for H1 2025 and H1 2026 (BS/IS/CF rows). Every column passes the identities in tools/check_transcripts.py (BS equation; insurance service result = revenue + service expenses + net reinsurance; total service result = direct + pool surplus; net insurance and investment result chain; profit before zakat chain; net income after zakat; cash-flow sum and roll; Q1+Q2=H1 and H1+Q3=9M chains). Four one-unit or footing differences are declared; 108 cross-filing differences are declared with both values and reason.

value_correctness.summary: SAR (whole). Transcribed headline sets: FY2022 (IFRS 4), FY2023, FY2024, FY2025; Q1/H1 2023; Q1/H1/9M 2024; Q1/H1/9M 2025; Q1/H1 2026 (14 sets, each with comparative columns, H1/9M with quarter columns). KEY FINDING: the FY2025 annual (note 33, read from text pp121-123) and the 9M 2025 filing restate 31 Dec 2023 and 31 Dec 2024 for a material prior-year error in expected premium receipts on insurance contracts (insurance contract assets overstated, liabilities understated) and a reversal of the statutory reserve transfer: total equity 800,684,313 (audited FY2023) -> 689,885,283; 813,091,361 (audited FY2024) -> 702,292,331; total assets 2,155,386,277 -> 2,062,069,139 and 2,048,366,016 -> 1,987,355,223. The note states income and cash flows of 2024 were not affected (FY2024 net income 15,167,075 identical in both; 2023 net income 36,986,892 is not re-presented in the pages read, although the note says the 2023 profit turns into a loss after restatement A: the restated 2023 income statement is NOT in any collected page, flagged as an open item). Other findings: (1) IFRS 17 transition restated 2022 (net income 19,919,347 IFRS 4 -> 8,575,802; equity 699,876,930 -> 745,679,703), and the 31 Dec 2022 balance sheet differs between the 2023 interims (2,119,368,916 / equity 748,744,118) and the FY2023 annual (2,050,052,354 / 745,679,703). (2) 2023 quarter comparatives printed as Restated in the 2024 interims differ from the 2023 originals in components (service expenses, pool surplus, investment income) with profit before zakat and net income unchanged. (3) H1 2023 original prints cash from operations 67,759,541 that does not foot (components 67,756,541); the 2024 comparative has 67,756,541. (4) H1 2026 net loss -22,021,909 (Q1 -10,628,132, Q2 -11,393,778) vs H1 2025 profit 14,524,232. Net income: FY2025 7,406,036; FY2024 15,167,075; FY2023 36,986,892; FY2022 19,919,347 (IFRS 4) / 8,575,802 (IFRS 17).
